verdict_reason: BD ORTHO (IGN) is open (Licence Ouverte 2.0), 20cm, France-only; page states annual millesime since 2000 but full-territory assembly only 'tous les 3 a 6 ans' - S2/AlphaEarth must bridge that gap, supporting the premise. No open national grubbing/CVI register exists (0 hits); only 2 regional, undated, single-campaign datasets. Labels must be constructed.

ground_truth.construction_protocol: Visual interpretation: analyst flags vine-row presence/absence per parcel across consecutive BD ORTHO millesimes, then dates the transition within the gap using S2/AlphaEarth annual change; spot-check subset against Gironde/Savoie parcel geometries.

compute_path.platform: Google Earth Engine (Sentinel-2 COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED, AlphaEarth GOOGLE/SATELLITE_EMBEDDING/V1/ANNUAL); BD ORTHO tiles direct-downloaded per departement
compute_path.why: S2/AlphaEarth run server-side in GEE; BD ORTHO is a small per-AOI tile download, classical CV row extraction, no sustained GPU training.
